resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package capable of HF, DFT, CC2, CCSD linear-response optical rotation calculations

access.notes: Agent may choose any package that supports the required calculations; must be able to compute optical rotation with and without GIAO/London orbitals and with user-specified gauge origin.
Standard correlation-consistent basis set; bundled with most quantum chemistry packages or available from Basis Set Exchange.

resources.name: Molecular identities of the target chiral molecules

access.notes: The set of molecules (1-11, 13, 14) from the original study: 1) 2S-2-methyloxirane, 2) (2R,3R)-trans-2,3-dimethyloxirane, 3) 2R-2-methylthiirane, 4) (2R,3R)-trans-2,3-dimethylthiirane, 5) (1S,2S)-trans-1,2-dimethylcyclopropane, 6) (2R,3R)-1-methylene-trans-2,3-dimethylcyclopropane, 7) (2R,3R)-trans-dimethylaziridine, 8) (2R,3R)-N-chloro-trans-2,3-dimethylaziridine, 9) (1S,2R)-cis-N-chloro-2-methylaziridine, 10) (1S,2R)-trans-N-chloro-2-methylaziridine, 11) (3S)-3-methylcyclobutene, 13) S-1,3-dimethylallene, 14) (1S,4S)-norbornenone. Agent may obtain initial 3D geometries from SMILES strings or Z-matrices using cheminformatics tools (e.g., RDKit) and then optimize at the required level.
